exact_replacements.current: Add your Antaeus address to the BCC line when you send outreach, and the send counts itself: it's matched to the account you're watching and logged as a touch — the outreach tallies, the "where you are with them" read, and your daily pace all pick it up. What gets saved: the subject line, who it went to, and when — never the message itself.
exact_replacements.replacement: Add your Antaeus address to the BCC line when you send outreach. Antaeus matches the send to a watched account and logs the activity. It stores the subject line, recipient, and send time, but not the message body.

exact_replacements.current: There's no dialer in Antaeus, on purpose — call from whatever you already use: your phone, Zoom, Meet, OpenPhone, Aircall. Here's how the calls still count:
exact_replacements.replacement: Antaeus does not include a dialer. Use your existing calling tool and log the result through the relevant Antaeus workflow.

exact_replacements.current: Cold calls: open Cold Call Studio before you dial — it hands you the game plan — and tap the outcome the moment you hang up (meeting booked, callback, voicemail…). A booked meeting creates the deal by itself.
exact_replacements.replacement: Cold calls: open Cold Call Studio before dialing to review the call plan, then log the outcome after the call. A booked meeting creates a deal automatically.

exact_replacements.current: Scheduled discovery calls: run the call inside Discovery Studio — it's built to be glanced at while you talk, and what you capture flows straight to the deal.
exact_replacements.replacement: Scheduled discovery calls: use Discovery Studio during the call. Notes and captured fields are added to the related deal.

exact_replacements.current: If your tool records or transcribes (Zoom, Meet, OpenPhone): after the call, skim the recap and put the two things that matter into the room you ran it from — what they admitted, and the dated next step. Two lines is enough; the rooms do the rest.
exact_replacements.replacement: If your calling tool records or transcribes the meeting, review the recap and add the key buyer information and dated next step to the relevant Antaeus workflow.

exact_replacements.current: Direct connections to call tools may come later. The habit above costs about thirty seconds a call and keeps every read honest today.

rules: Do not rename standard sales concepts solely for brand voice.
Keep conversational scripts conversational; remove only private Antaeus ontology, unsupported certainty, and obscuring metaphors.
Do not imply causality from correlation.
Deal-risk language must expose the evidence driving the assessment.
Quota projections must identify their assumptions.
Settings language must describe actual storage/integration behavior directly.
